profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (Nasdaq: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site positions the company as serving security professionals including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, with offerings spanning network security, cloud workload protection, hybrid workforce security, threat intelligence, and security consulting built around a Zero Trust architecture.

The company's tracked AI product is Precision AI, described as a network security AI system with Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response capabilities, and applicability to critical infrastructure. The site also describes the Strata Network Security Platform as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI, said to proactively monitor, analyze, and prevent sophisticated threats in real time, and an AI-driven SecOps platform focused on transforming security operations centers through unified data, artificial intelligence, and automation. Additionally, the site introduces Idira, described as a next-generation identity security platform intended to secure every identity for the AI enterprise.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC enforcement actions, or patent filings beyond the standard public company registration appear in the held facts for Palo Alto Networks.
